title: Cabin Mix Terms and the Spend-Milestone Bonus, Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Definition.** For a spend-milestone bonus on a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement, the premium cabin share is the flown coupons on the company's tickets flown in First or Premium Economy, divided by all flown coupons on the company's tickets, both placed by flight date in the premium-share window of 12 calendar months up to and including the credit date, in percent. The cabin is the cabin the passenger actually flew, as recorded on each flown coupon in the fare ledger of the company's tickets under Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand. When no coupon was flown in the window, the share is 0 percent.

**Uplift.** The premium cabin share adds a premium uplift:

| Premium cabin share | Premium uplift |
|---|---|
| 50 percent or more | 20 percentage points |
| 25 percent or more, and below 50 | 10 percentage points |
| below 25 percent | nothing |

**How the uplift acts.** The uplift is counted in percentage points; milestone uplifts on different grounds are added together, and the milestone bonus is raised by the total: the milestone bonus before its allowance is the milestone bonus multiplied by one hundred plus the total uplift, divided by one hundred, rounded down to the whole point.

### Worked shares (hypothetical coupon counts)

| First coupons | Premium Economy coupons | All flown coupons | Share | Uplift |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 4 | 20 | 50 percent | 20 percentage points |
| 3 | 3 | 24 | 25 percent | 10 percentage points |
| 2 | 3 | 21 | about 23.8 percent | nothing |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 percent | nothing |
